visual.caption: 圖 1｜從授權到可核對的結果
visual.description: 箭頭代表工作順序。每一步限定下一步的範圍，不代表完成掃描就證明安全。

items.title: 授權與問題
items.body: 確認目標、排除項目、時段、來源與停止條件。

items.title: 最小必要設定
items.body: 選定協定、連接埠及方法，逐項確認附加功能。

items.title: 保留原始結果
items.body: 保存命令、版本、時間、回應、警告與未完成範圍。

items.title: 比對與核實
items.body: 以管理端設定、程序及日誌核對，再決定下一步。

visual.caption: Figure 1｜From permission to verifiable results
visual.description: Arrows show work order. Each stage bounds the next; completing a scan does not establish overall security.

items.title: Permission and question
items.body: Confirm targets, exclusions, time, source and stop conditions.

items.title: Minimum settings
items.body: Choose protocol, ports and method; check each added capability.

items.title: Preserve raw results
items.body: Keep command, version, time, responses, warnings and unfinished scope.

items.title: Compare and verify
items.body: Check management settings, processes and logs before deciding what follows.

visual.caption: 圖 4｜三種證據角色分開記錄
visual.description: 以下是平行比較，沒有先後箭頭。每張卡說明不同證據能支持的結論。

items.title: 單次觀察
items.body: 在指定來源、時間與方法下，8000/tcp 接受連線。

items.title: 工具推論
items.body: 服務或系統候選需要相應探測；埠號本身不等於版本。

items.title: 管理端核實
items.body: 由負責人核對執行中程序、設定及日誌，對齊設備與時間。

visual.caption: Figure 4｜Keep three evidence roles separate
visual.description: These are parallel comparisons, without sequence arrows. Each card shows the conclusion a different evidence type supports.

items.title: Single observation
items.body: 8000/tcp accepted a connection from the specified source, time and method.

items.title: Tool inference
items.body: Service or OS candidates need relevant probes; a port number is not a version.

items.title: Management verification
items.body: The owner checks running processes, settings and logs for the same device and time.

visual.caption: 圖 2｜同一入口，兩個觀察位置
visual.description: 兩張卡是獨立測試條件，不是先後流程。這是人工示例，須以來源、路徑及日誌核實。

items.title: 內部管理電腦 → NAS TCP 8000
items.body: 人工示例：open。只支持這次內網來源能連線。

items.title: 經核准的外部位置 → 同一 NAS
items.body: 人工示例：filtered。無法確定入口是否開啟；需核對防火牆與路徑。

visual.caption: Figure 2 | Two observation positions
visual.description: These are separate test conditions, not a sequence. This synthetic example needs source, path and log checks.

items.title: Internal computer → NAS TCP 8000
items.body: Synthetic: open. Supports access from this internal source only.

items.title: Approved external source → same NAS
items.body: Synthetic: filtered. Check path and firewall; service state is uncertain.

visual.caption: 圖 3｜掃描的三個資訊層次
visual.description: 這是不同問題的比較，不代表每次都要依序啟動全部功能。每項功能須符合核准目的。

items.title: 主機探索：-sn／-Pn
items.body: -sn 不掃連接埠；-Pn 跳過一般探索判定，不是存活證據。

items.title: 連接埠與狀態：-sT／-p
items.body: 指定方法與入口，判讀 open、closed、filtered 及其理由。

items.title: 服務與系統：-sV／-O
items.body: 額外探測提供身分線索；由管理端核實實際服務及系統。

visual.caption: Figure 3 | Three information layers
visual.description: These answer different questions; a scan need not run every layer. Match each capability to authorization.

items.title: Host discovery: -sn / -Pn
items.body: -sn skips port scans; -Pn skips the discovery decision, not firewall rules.

items.title: Ports and states: -sT / -p
items.body: Choose method and ports; interpret states with their reasons.

items.title: Service and OS: -sV / -O
items.body: Extra probes suggest identities. Verify them using management evidence.
